general.autostartDesc: Start InkCity automatically when you log in.
general.hideTrayDescOn: With the status bar icon hidden, relaunch the app to reopen this window.
general.hideTrayDescOff: Keep the status bar icon visible.
general.updateCheckDesc: Notify me when a new version is available.
general.autoUpdateDesc: Download and install new versions on the schedule above, then restart — no confirmation needed.
general.updateUnavailable: Update server unavailable, try again later
general.proxyDesc: Route map data requests through a proxy, for networks where OpenStreetMap is unreachable directly. Supports http:// and socks5:// URLs.

city.locationPlaceholder: City name, coordinates, or a map link
city.invalidLocation: No matching city — try coordinates, e.g. 51.5074, -0.1278.
city.customRateHint: Custom locations aren't precached — each Apply fetches map data live, so avoid applying many new locations in quick succession or you may hit the service's rate limit.

lab.intro: These features are experimental, may be buggy, and aren't guaranteed to work.
lab.airportsHint: Airport runways and taxiways are drawn in the line color.
lab.railwaysHint: Surface rail lines are drawn as a dashed line in the line color.
lab.aerialwaysHint: Cable cars and ropeways are drawn as a dotted line in the line color.
lab.waterHint: Rivers, lakes and sea are tinted with the line color.
lab.mondrianHint: Paint the map as a Mondrian composition: black roads on white, with a few blocks filled in primary colors. Replaces the theme colors; the layers above still apply.

about.p1: InkCity sets your desktop wallpaper to a road map of a different city every day.
about.feedbackDesc: Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue on GitHub. For bug reports please include your OS version, and if relevant the city / date that triggered the problem.
about.logsDesc: InkCity keeps a log file to help diagnose problems. Attach it when reporting a bug.
about.osmAttribution: Road map data © <0>OpenStreetMap</0> contributors, licensed under <1>ODbL</1>.
about.geonamesAttribution: City list from <0>GeoNames</0>, licensed under <1>CC BY 4.0</1>.
about.designCredit: App icon and map visual design by {{name}}

devMode.advancePreviewDesc: Render an upcoming day and cache it like a normal render — the map data and image land in the daily cache, ready for when that day arrives. Doesn't change today's wallpaper.
devMode.cleanCacheDesc: Delete downloaded map data and rendered wallpapers. They're re-fetched and re-rendered on the next update.
devMode.bypassCacheDesc: Take the day's city from the schedule read straight off GitHub, then fetch its map data live from the Overpass API instead of the CDN, overwriting the local cache. Use when testing edits to the map data. Resets to off on restart.
devMode.dailyOnly: Only applies to the Daily update mode.

update.notifyBody: New version {version} is available — open InkCity to update.
update.failed: Update failed. Please try again later.
